exposure: family history of UI (mother or sister)
cohort: The study included 425 primiparous non-menopausal women with no personal history of pregestational UI, followed up 5 to 10 years after childbirth.
finding: The occurrence of UI in primiparous, non-menopausal women years after childbirth is significantly associated with vaginal delivery, a family history of UI, and the presence of chronic diseases or comorbidities.
mod_finding: Women who delivered by cesarean section showed a lower risk of developing UI compared to those who had a vaginal delivery.
